mechanisms.title: Item Category Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: The item category is the item's operating license.
mechanisms.question: What is this sales item allowed to do?
failure_proof: unexpected item category → document type + item category group + usage + higher-level item
no schedule line/wrong billing → prove item category before downstream debugging

mechanisms.title: Partner Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: A document is not just what was sold; it is who is allowed to play each role.
mechanisms.question: Who is sold-to, ship-to, bill-to, payer, contact, or another process partner, and why?
mechanisms.output: partner functions at header and/or item level
failure_proof: wrong payer/ship-to → procedure assignment + mandatory functions + source control + master relationships
route/output/billing differs → compare actual document partners first

mechanisms.title: Pricing
mechanisms.memory_hook: First prove the procedure. Only then hunt the condition record.
mechanisms.question: Which pricing procedure runs, and how does it find each price element?
mechanisms.debug_path: pricing procedure → condition type → access sequence → condition table/key → valid condition record → requirement/formula/exclusion

mechanisms.title: Copy Control
mechanisms.memory_hook: A follow-on document inherits rules, not just fields.
mechanisms.question: What is allowed to flow from source to target, and what is redetermined?
mechanisms.output: target content / reference status / pricing-copy behavior
failure_proof: reference cannot be created → source/target + item entry + requirement + status/completion
wrong price/quantity in target → pricing type + quantity rule + transfer routine
